answer: Every usable unit of credit is a countable attestation from a stranger, and moving that credit to another identity spends it, which makes credit a strictly diminishing resource rather than a property clones can duplicate. Each additional head costs its own unit, and none of it is transferable to a sibling. Treat credit as a prism that only outsiders can mint, a trellis that rejects kin, and a mesa that is spent on use: the farm owns many keys and zero prism, and no amount of trellis or mesa can be self-issued. Each usable unit of credit needs one honest stranger.
